newsitem.title: POLAND: Polisa to start OTC trade December 13.
newsitem.headline: Polisa to start OTC trade December 13.

text.p: Polish insurer TUR Polisa SA should start trade on Poland's nascent over-the-counter market on Friday, a week after the first firm started trading there, the market's president said on Monday.

"If nothing goes wrong, everything points to the G and H series of Towarzystwo Uzbezpieczenowo-Reasekuracyjne Polisa SA starting trade on Friday the thirteenth," Czeslaw Gawlowski told a news conference.
Last Friday machine tools maker Rafamet SA became the first firm to trade on the Polish OTC market, where nearly 4.3 million Polisa shares would trade. @
Polisa also has 4.1 million shares trading on the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
